subject.title: fix: prevent doctor hangs on large Memory Core migrations

question: Is the 10,000-row isolated SQL benchmark sufficient for this protected migration PR, or must merge wait for a representative end-to-end `openclaw doctor --fix` run on a large legacy Memory Core database?
rationale: The implementation aligns with the source-level bottleneck, but the changed path imports and archives persisted upgrade state while the current proof does not exercise the complete operator workflow.

options.title: Require full migration proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted large-database Doctor run with timing, row counts, integrity checks, WAL behavior, conflict preservation, and archive confirmation.

options.title: Accept focused SQL proof
options.body: Treat the 508x isolated benchmark and focused migration tests as sufficient because the patch changes only the FTS validation query shape.

recommendation.title: Require full migration proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted large-database Doctor run with timing, row counts, integrity checks, WAL behavior, conflict preservation, and archive confirmation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work by this person defines the sidecar conflict, transaction, and archival behavior that the optimization must preserve.
